messages.author: d3505b00e1ffcec0
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Questions on Lsoda
parts:
Hi Yuzhao,

Since the functions that you pass to lsoda are functions of t,y, and parms, you should be able to include time-dependence (e.g. piecewise defined functions for discrete changes in parameters) within this function directly. For example if you want to break up yearly intervals into four seasons and only change parameter values at the changes in the season, you can use a conditional statement in conjunction with the modulus operator in R within this function. 

Cheers, Sebastian
